verdict.rationale: ADK ships a well-documented Python API/SDK (agents, tools, workflows, MCP client/server, callbacks, plugins) plus a CLI (`adk run`, `adk deploy`) that let developers and AI-native tooling programmatically construct, run, and deploy agents, all documented on google.github.io/adk-docs and the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/REST spec or llms.txt machine-readable API index (probes 404), so it's a code-level API rather than a standardized web API surface.
